"""
	Section button onClick - trigger accordion toggle.
	
	Version: 1.1.0
	
	Changelog:
		2026-07-05 | William | v1.0.0 - Initial version
		2026-07-05 | William | v1.1.0 - Dynamic, hierarchy-independent
	"""
	
	# Extract section index from component name
	sectionIndex = int(self.meta.name.replace("Section", ""))
	
	# Trigger accordion toggle on root
	self.view.getChild("root").toggleFlexRoot(sectionIndex)

# Query parametrizada
	query = """
		SELECT Description
		FROM papoitem
		WHERE ID = ?
	"""
	
	# args recibe el ID que pasas en "value" o podrías sustituirlo por otra variable
	args = [value]
	
	# Ejecutar consulta
	results = system.db.runPrepQuery(query, args, self.view.custom.db)
	
	# Si hay resultados, devolver la descripción
	if len(results) > 0:
		return results[0]["Description"]
	else:
		return None

# Transform the array to dropdown format
	if value is None or len(value) == 0:
		return [{"label": "No hay supervisores disponibles", "value": ""}]
	
	return [{"label": user, "value": user} for user in value]
